nodes.label: Per-Sink Isolation
nodes.rationale: Failure in one sink must not affect others; each Consumer is isolated per sink target

nodes.label: Transport Decision
nodes.rationale: InProcStream chosen (bounded chan + spillover) for zero infra dependency and ~100us latency; external broker is an opt-in adapter

nodes.label: Serialization Decision
nodes.rationale: MessagePack via tinylib/msgp chosen over protobuf/avro for Go-idiomatic, code-generated, zero-alloc performance
